topology: Bounded, cell-anchored 3×3×3 rectangular grid with all 27 sites in the placement domain.
source_xy_policy: Preserve three X and three Y positions, cell placement and X/O alternation.
target_z: Add three bounded Z layers, indexed 0–2.
neighborhood: Winning lines use every straight 3D direction, not movement adjacency.
movement: Place directly in any empty site without gravity; reject occupied, out-of-bounds and post-terminal moves.
outcomes: Any of 49 straight lines wins before the full-board draw check; a draw requires 27 occupied cells without a winner.
presentation: Preserve source slate cells, blue crosses, amber rings and turn/result messages across three visible layers.
input: Route selection to rule:action.place with event_data.rule_coordinate; use host_command restart for R and host_command quit for Escape. Camera controls must not maintain gameplay state.
z_equals_one_tests: Check the eight source winning lines, occupied-cell rejection, alternation and nine-cell draw when Z has one layer.
z_gt_one_tests: Check all 49 lines, center selection, no gravity, occupied-cell rejection, full-volume draw and post-terminal rejection.
